title: Shellshock: Jus' Keepin' da Peace
overview:
We keep the world.

Storm into danger zones around the world, crush vicious terrorism and conflicts, rescue hostages from the hands of evil, and expose the corruption of crooked politicians - that is the mission of us, "Da Wardenz". Pilot the invincible high-performance tank Predator M-13 and mow down the enemies closing in.

世界は俺たちがキープする。

世界中の危険地域に殴り込み、凶悪なテロや紛争を制圧、悪の手から人質を救出し悪徳政治家の汚職を暴き出す、それが俺たち「ダ・ウォルデンツ」の任務だ。無敵の高性能戦車プレデターM-13を操り、迫り来る敵をなぎ倒せ。
